description: Monthly budget targets per category with a dashboard showing budget vs. actual spending, income tracking, net cash flow, and rolling averages. This is the core value proposition — the reason to replace Monarch Money.

timing.gatingCondition: Features 2 + 3 complete — categories established, historical data imported, auto-categorization rules in place.

principles: Budget math must be bulletproof — transfers excluded, income separated, rounding handled
Visual hierarchy: over-budget categories should scream, on-track categories should fade
Rolling averages provide context — 'you usually spend X' is more useful than just 'you budgeted X'
Dashboard loads fast — precomputed snapshots, not real-time aggregation on every page load

techStack.database: PostgreSQL with materialized budget period snapshots
techStack.testing: Jest for budget calculation logic, Playwright for dashboard UI

userStories.title: Monthly budget targets per category
acceptanceCriteria: Admin UI to set monthly budget target for each spending category
Budget stored in budgets table: category_id, monthly_amount, effective_from date
Budget amounts carry forward month-to-month until changed
Income and transfer categories excluded from budget targets
Total monthly budget displayed as sum of all category budgets
userStories.testStrategy: CRUD API tests for budget targets. Carry-forward logic test. Total calculation test excluding income/transfers.

userStories.title: Budget dashboard — category cards
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard page showing current month at a glance
Category cards: name, icon, budget amount, spent amount, remaining, percentage bar
Color coding: green (<70% used), yellow (70-99%), red (>=100% / over budget)
Cards sorted: over-budget first, then by percentage used descending
Click card to drill into category's transactions for current month
Responsive grid: 2 columns on mobile, 3-4 on desktop
userStories.testStrategy: Budget calculation API tests with known data. Color threshold tests. Sort order test. Drill-down links verified.

userStories.title: Income tracking and net cash flow
acceptanceCriteria: Income transactions detected via is_income category flag and payroll patterns
Monthly income total displayed on dashboard
Net cash flow: income minus non-transfer, non-income spending
Net cash flow color: green (positive), red (negative)
Month-over-month cash flow comparison (current vs. prior month)
userStories.testStrategy: Income detection unit tests. Net cash flow calculation with transfers excluded. Month-over-month comparison test.

userStories.title: Rolling 3-month average per category
acceptanceCriteria: Compute rolling 3-month average spend for each category
Displayed on category cards as 'typical: $X/mo' alongside budget
Average excludes current (incomplete) month
Handles categories with <3 months of data gracefully (shows available average)
Stored in budget_periods table as monthly snapshots for performance
userStories.testStrategy: Rolling average calculation tests with known data sets (3 months, 2 months, 1 month, 0 months). Snapshot generation test.

userStories.title: Budget period snapshots
acceptanceCriteria: End-of-month job computes and stores budget_periods snapshot
Snapshot includes: category_id, period (YYYY-MM), budgeted, actual_spent, income, net_cash_flow
Snapshots enable fast historical comparison without re-aggregating transactions
Manual snapshot trigger available via admin for backfill
Historical months (from Monarch import) backfilled on first run
userStories.testStrategy: Snapshot generation test with known transactions. Backfill test against imported Monarch data. Idempotency test.

high: Budget calculations must perfectly exclude transfers — any leak inflates spending and destroys trust in the tool
medium: Uncategorized transactions create blind spots in budget tracking — need prominent indicator of uncategorized spend
Rolling average meaningless if categories were renamed/merged during Monarch import
low: Mid-month category changes affect budget calculations — decide if changes apply retroactively or next month

preFlightChecklist: Confirm initial budget amounts for major categories (Eric to provide)
Decide: does changing a budget target apply to current month or next month?
Decide: how to handle uncategorized spending in budget view — separate 'uncategorized' card or warning banner?
